registration_timing: After the canonical bootstrap fit result and an interactive 1-to-6-decimal display check were inspected, but before implementation or inspection of the threshold-grid surface. This is explicitly post-result descriptive analysis, not a confirmatory registration.
purpose: Separate display-rounding sensitivity from dependence on the substantive 0.50/1.50/2.00 MnSq classification thresholds without selecting a data-favorable threshold or relabelling bootstrap transitions as operating characteristics.

canonical_contract.endpoint_semantics: value < overfit_upper is overfit; exact overfit_upper through exact acceptable_upper are acceptable; above acceptable_upper through exact noisy_upper are noisy; above noisy_upper is distorting.

threshold_grid.one_at_a_time_profiles: For each threshold, vary its five frozen values while holding the other two at the canonical values.

display_precision_grid.status: post-hoc durable reconstruction of an already inspected interactive check
display_precision_grid.comparison: Classify rounded replicate and rounded baseline values, then compare both class labels and transition indicators against raw classification.
display_precision_grid.rounding_mode: numpy binary64 round-to-nearest behavior used by the existing display audit

proximity_bands.purpose: Describe empirical mass near each canonical threshold; not an uncertainty interval or recommended tolerance.

required_outputs.full_threshold_surface: Transition count/share for every Model x Lane x Statistic x threshold triplet plus aggregate Infit, Outfit, and any-statistic totals.
required_outputs.one_at_a_time_profile: Transition counts and raw-canonical differences for each individually varied threshold.
required_outputs.display_precision_profile: Raw versus rounded class mismatches and raw versus rounded transition-indicator disagreements for one through six decimals.
required_outputs.proximity_profile: Counts and shares within every frozen raw-distance band by threshold and stratum.
required_outputs.person_concentration: Minimum, maximum, and range of Person transition shares across the full threshold grid.
visuals: one-at-a-time threshold profiles with canonical reference
required_outputs.first_read_projection: Separate raw reproduction, display precision, threshold dependence, and withheld validity/UI claims.

next_confirmatory_gate: Register a known-truth repeated simulation varying observations per Person, missingness/connectivity, categories, local dependence, model misspecification, and anchor proportion/contamination before evaluating false-positive, power, or threshold recommendations.
